definition.name: Twenty native controls and one bank consumer on the qualified kernel

steps.name: Check closed image selection and bank observation refusal controls
Install only the normal static linker and isolated emulator prerequisites
steps.run:
sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 180s apt-get update
sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 900s apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends gcc libc6-dev qemu-system-x86 seabios

steps.name: Reuse the authenticated kernel and execute one new bank consumer
Retain actual current consumer and unchanged kernel provenance

with.name: stream-kernel-bank-vm-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/receipt.json
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/commands.json
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/source-inputs.json
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/native-init
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/bank-consumer-initramfs.cpio
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/kernel/origin.json
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/kernel/qualified-observation-image.zip
${{ runner.temp }}/stream-kernel-bank-vm/commands/logs/*.txt

reviewReason: Reviewed security fork identities only; commands, permissions, inputs, conditions and historical coverage are preserved.
